job.title: Digital Product Manager (m/f/d) Webshop & Digital Tools
job.email_subject: Application: Digital Product Manager Webshop & Digital Tools – Kranti Chavan
job.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

You need a product manager who can drive your webshop and digital tools with both business and technical insight – I have shaped industrial B2B commerce at Rockwell Automation and Shell for 5+ years.

– Requirements analysis, user stories, functional specifications and UAT with business teams
– B2B webshop know-how: catalog, PIM, pricing, promotions, order management
– Extensive use of generative AI / LLM tools in analysis, development and documentation

Coming from industrial B2B commerce, I understand engineering-driven products like Ensinger's and the expectations of professional buyers. My CV and cover letter are attached. I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. Could we arrange a short call this week or next?

Kind regards
Kranti Chavan

tailoring.headline: Digital Product Manager Webshop | Techno-Functional E-Commerce, B2B Commerce
tailoring.summary: Techno-functional e-commerce professional with 5+ years shaping B2B webshops and digital commerce tools on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) for industrial companies Rockwell Automation and Shell. Turns business needs into user stories, functional specifications and solution designs, prioritizes with stakeholders and steers delivery with development teams in agile setups (Scrum, PI Planning, Jira). Deep know-how in product catalog and PIM, pricing, promotions, order management and ERP integration. Uses generative AI tools for analysis and documentation.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

tailoring.why_company: Ensinger sells high-performance plastics to professional B2B buyers, very close to the industrial commerce I know from Rockwell Automation. I want to use my experience with B2B webshops, product data and digital tools to make it easier for your customers to select and order the right materials online.

en.subject: Application: Digital Product Manager Webshop & Digital Tools
en.hook: An industrial webshop wins when customers find the right product, price and data quickly – and that is what I have built for more than five years. At Rockwell Automation and Shell I shaped B2B commerce on SAP Commerce Cloud from requirements to rollout, working directly with business stakeholders and development teams.

bullets.label: Webshop functionality
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend and frontend functionality for product, catalog, pricing and customer data on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211); developed and maintained the Promotions Engine, Order Management (OMS), Cronjobs, Impex and FlexibleSearch.

bullets.label: Requirements to roadmap
bullets.text: Analysed requirements with business stakeholders and product owners, wrote user stories and functional specifications, mapped processes and supported user acceptance testing (UAT) – then translated them into working SAP Commerce solutions.

bullets.label: Product data & integration
bullets.text: Designed, built and optimized PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines with Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub; investigated and resolved integration bottlenecks between SAP ERP, MDM and Profisee with international technical teams.

bullets.label: Digital tools & AI
bullets.text: Used generative AI / LLM tools extensively to accelerate analysis, development, testing and documentation in day-to-day delivery.

en.logistics: Coming from industrial B2B commerce, I understand engineering-driven products like Ensinger's and the expectations of professional buyers. I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. I would be glad to show you in a conversation how I can contribute from day one.
